No outbound (India→abroad) bill of lading with an Indian shipper and foreign consignee was seen on any page read. domestic_evidence: Company operates a pan-India retail/enterprise ISP business under the ACT Fibernet brand with live commercial service pages listing 30+ Indian cities, e.g. actcorp.in homepage: 'ACT Fibernet users can test their internet speed easily using the ACT app' and city list 'Bengaluru Chennai Delhi Hyderabad Ahmedabad ... Visakhapatnam Warangal'; investors page confirms PE ownership: 'True North (formerly known as India Value Fund Advisors - IVFA)' and 'TA Associates'. This is direct evidence of ongoing domestic supply of services to Indian subscribers. Source counter: actcorp.in pages read = 3 (homepage, /investors, /about-us 404); no GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split was retrievable in this session (search engine returned connection errors; thecompanycheck.in returned HTTP 403), so revenue/export value = null.
note: Declared HS 997331 (telecom/IT infrastructure support services) is a services classification, not a goods code — consistent with an ISP, and per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground. Actual customs activity found is IMPORT-only (network switches, optical transceivers, SFP modules from Taiwan/China/Hong Kong, HS 85176290), which is the company's own capex procurement, not resale. No export shipments found: 'следов экспортных поставок не найдено'. Domestic supply is confirmed by live commercial broadband operations across 30+ Indian cities; however no GST turnover band, tender award or audited revenue figure could be verified from a public source in this session, so revenue and export volume are recorded as null rather than estimated. Company is a large private-equity-backed ISP (True North, TA Associates), not a goods trader — role would be end-user/service provider rather than manufacturer or trader.
